entities.name: The Great Glory on the Crystal Throne (Enoch 14:18-22)
entities.scripture: Enoch 14:20 — 'The Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.'

entities.name: The Seraphim — Six-Winged Fiery Spirits (Enoch 61:10, 71:7)
entities.scripture: Enoch 71:7 — 'And round about were Seraphim, Cherubim, and Ophanim: these are they who sleep not and guard the throne of His glory.'

entities.name: The Cherubim (Enoch 14:11, 71:7)
entities.scripture: Enoch 14:11 — 'And the ceiling was like the path of the stars and the lightnings, and between them were fiery cherubim.'

entities.name: The Ophanim — Wheels of Eyes (Enoch 61:10, 71:7)
entities.scripture: Enoch 61:10 — 'And all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above... the Cherubim, the Seraphim, and the Ophanim.'

entities.name: Archangel Michael (Enoch 20:5, 71:3)
entities.scripture: Enoch 20:5 — 'Michael, one of the holy angels, set over the best part of mankind and over chaos.'

entities.name: Archangel Uriel (Enoch 20:2, 19:1)
entities.scripture: Enoch 20:2 — 'Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.'

entities.name: Archangel Raphael (Enoch 20:3, 10:4)
entities.scripture: Enoch 20:3 — 'Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.'

entities.name: Archangel Gabriel (Enoch 20:7, 10:9)
entities.scripture: Enoch 20:7 — 'Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise, the serpents, and the Cherubim.'

entities.name: Archangel Phanuel (Enoch 40:9)
entities.scripture: Enoch 40:9 — 'And the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.'

entities.name: Semyaza — Leader of Fallen Watchers (Enoch 6:3, 10:11)
entities.scripture: Enoch 6:3 — 'And Semjaza, who was their leader, said unto them: I fear ye will not indeed agree to do this deed.'

entities.name: Azazel — Bound in Dudael Darkness (Enoch 8:1, 10:4)
entities.scripture: Enoch 10:4 — 'Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dudael, and cast him therein.'

entities.name: Enoch the Scribe (Enoch 12:3, 14:24)
entities.scripture: Enoch 14:24 — 'And the Lord called me with His own mouth, and said to me: Come hither, Enoch, and hear my word.'
